title: HomeMind paired-phone list or unpair request from the 7-inch UI to the Mobile API
description: NODE-RPI5-01 (UI 'phone connect' screen) to homemind-mobile-api on NODE-RPI4-01 (added 2026-10-25). action list: send the phones that hold a valid token. action revoke: unpair phone_id now, so its token is refused on the phone's next request and the phone shows the pairing QR gate again. The Mobile API answers on pfn/v1/mobile/phones/state with the same request_id. It ignores a request whose expires_at_ms has passed or whose request_id it has seen, so a press is never replayed after a reconnect. Carries no secret. Core does not subscribe.

phone_id.description: Token id from the state message (never the token).
